episodes.name: learning_20260422_222354
episodes.content: **Persona embed identity**: Use the Agent Hub embed bridge for host-mounted persona chat surfaces. Never hardcode persona display strings. Why: The persona row is the source of truth for display identity.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_161435
episodes.content: **Reference Repos**: Use ~/references/ for cloned third-party repos. Current: aperant (formerly auto-claude), openclaw, claude-mem, cmux, autoresearch.

episodes.name: learning_20260318_145324
episodes.content: **Snapshot Jumping**: Fix applySnapshot (term.reset + term.write) in use-terminal-write-queue.ts to reduce visual disruption. Never remove the snapshot path — scrolling depends on it. The 1-2 row jumping in TUI sessions is caused by full terminal wipe+rewrite during active rendering.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_153756
episodes.content: **Mobile Dropdown Source**: Use session-level reasoning for the current A-Term mobile dropdown. Never assume one dropdown row equals one pane. Why: The mobile slot list comes from raw sessions, while project panes can own both shell and agent sessions.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_163615
episodes.content: **True Edge**: Prefer fewer better trades. Focus on filtering weak setups, sizing risk, and managing exits. Recommend no action when setup quality or risk reward is weak.

episodes.name: learning_20260428_185612
episodes.content: **Browser Checks**: Run st browser check sequentially on shared ST_BROWSER_HOST. Never parallelize site health checks through the same browser target. Why: sessions can cross-talk and report wrong page evidence.

episodes.name: learning_20260313_150817
episodes.content: **Terminal Replay Queue**: Use a bounded xterm write queue. Let a newer scrollback snapshot replace older queued terminal work, and merge adjacent live writes. Why: authoritative shell replays can otherwise grow browser CPU and RAM over long sessions.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_001344
episodes.content: **No Grok Fallback**: Never use Grok/xAI by default. Use it only when user asks.

episodes.name: learning_20260426_164830
episodes.content: **Pulse Preflight**: Run st pulse --gate once; if PREFLIGHT clear, edit. Never inspect sessions/ownership unless blocked. If blocked, fix only listed concrete reasons; inspect dirty jj once, then commit/push coherent work or continue narrow.

episodes.name: learning_20260226_141914
episodes.content: **Monkey Fight Architecture**: Phaser 3.80 TypeScript, Vite bundled. Scenes: TitleScene (char select) | IntroScene (7-panel story) | GameScene (1v1 fighting arena). Combat: PlayerController, AIManager, AttackExecutor, SpecialAbility, ProjectileFactory. Audio: ChiptuneEngine, RetroSFX, AudioManager (all procedural). Effects: punchImpact, DustEffect, SpeedLines, ScreenEffects. UI: UIManager, HUDManager, MobileControls, UpgradeShop, EndScreen, PauseMenu, TutorialOverlay, IdeaChatWidget. Two playable chars (Coco gorilla, Kiki capuchin) vs Gnash mandrill AI. Full combat with combos, projectiles, specials. Upgrade shop between rounds. 6-layer parallax. Dynamic chiptune with intensity. Mobile: floating joystick, haptic, input buffer. PWA. Dev port 4001.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_004547
episodes.content: **Infrastructure Map**: Use summitflow-prod (192.168.8.244) as production — Hyper-V VM on davion-sidar (192.168.8.128), 16GB RAM, 97GB disk. Use davion-gem (192.168.8.233) as Proxmox VE 9.1.1 test/staging hypervisor (16-core AMD Ryzen 7, 30GB RAM, 938GB NVMe). Router DNS points to .244.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_230431
episodes.content: **SHA backup scratch dirs**: Use shared backup exclusions .tmp and .tmp-* for managed project backups. Why: SHA had a 39G .tmp-winvm directory that made backup tar staging fail.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_231307
episodes.content: **Tool error verification**: Treat any tool result with an error as a failed action, not a completed one. Do not claim persistence or success for memory writes until the save path succeeds and the saved entry is verified. Why: Prevents silent state drift when a save fails due to capacity, scope, or transport issues.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: learning_20260430_124956
episodes.content: **Graphify Community Labels**: Use deterministic labels for large aggregated HTML: dominant source path plus high-degree symbols. Avoid generic Community N labels in Graphify visuals. Refresh with graphify update root after label logic changes.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_191129
episodes.content: **Self-evolution Push Access**: Avoid direct push attempts to NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution from the elias-leslie GitHub identity. Never assume origin is writable there. Why: Origin push returns HTTP 403.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_170030
episodes.content: **Install.sh CI**: Use scripts/test-install.sh to validate install.sh on Proxmox test VMs. Modes: full cycle (clone→install→verify→destroy), --existing (test on VM 100), --keep (preserve VM for debugging). Copies install.sh via scp, verifies all service health endpoints.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_163615
episodes.content: **Financial Precision**: Never invent stops, targets, or confidence. Mark unavailable, lower confidence, or avoid when ATR, freshness, or supporting evidence is missing or stale.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_163615
episodes.content: **Investor Profile**: Serve solo long-only investor. Prefer capital preservation, selective action, plain language. Never recommend shorting, margin, or complex options unless user asks.

episodes.name: learning_20260428_160751
episodes.content: **ST JJ VCS**: Use `st jj --help` as source of truth. Use `st jj` and `st commit -m "..." --push --task <id>` for normal work. Never use raw git/jj except recovery gaps; add missing flows to `st jj`.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_140721
episodes.content: **Hermes Profile Isolation**: Check profile-local config.yaml, .env, and auth.json when tuning or auditing named Hermes profiles. Never assume coder/research inherit the default profile's Codex auth or compression settings. Why: Named profiles can look healthy on model settings but still be effectively logged out or untuned.

episodes.name: learning_20260312_233054
episodes.content: **uv sync extras**: Use 'uv sync --extra dev' in the local agent/dev shell for managed backend repos when you expect to run dt, pytest, ruff, or ty after dependency changes. Use plain 'uv sync' only for intentional production-only .venv syncs because it removes dev-only tools from .venv.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:agent-hub backend dependency upgrade on 2026-03-12

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:54:03.292630+00:00
episodes.content: **Error Handling Anti-Patterns**: Never empty catch block (log with context, then handle or rethrow). Never hide stack traces (surface to user/logs). Never silent failure (fail fast, visible error). Never swallow async errors (always .catch() or try/await). Never generic "something went wrong" (specific actionable error message).

episodes.name: learning_20260310_195626
episodes.content: **Facade Collaborator Split**: Keep HouseholdFinanceService and JennyOperatorService as route-facing facades while moving document intake/reconciliation and Jenny symbol-profile/read-model logic into focused collaborator services. Prefer DB-backed memory for these patterns rather than checked-in process docs.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_235325
episodes.content: **Next.js frontend shutdown behavior**: Treat KillMode=mixed on workspace Next.js frontend units as suspicious when next-server children survive restart. Do not assume a-term shares the exact fix; it can still timeout under control-group with active localhost connections. Why: This prevents repeat debugging of the same restart-noise pattern.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_183159
episodes.content: **Runtime Hygiene Source**: Use SummitFlow runtime hygiene as source of truth. Never infer host, backup, bloat, or follow-up task state without that run. Why: Agent Hub follow-through and Hermes Telegram digest read downstream from it.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_140927
episodes.content: **Hermes Update Branch Behavior**: Check whether a Hermes source checkout is on `main` before relying on `hermes update`. Never assume `hermes update` switches back to the original non-main branch after a real update. Why: A non-main checkout can be left on `main` after updates.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_222714
episodes.content: **Session Reference UI**: Show session reference effectiveness from session events. Render refs <selected>/<index> cited <selected_cited>/<selected> in session header. Render selected/index counts plus selected citation rate in Info tab. Derive from memory_inject and memory_cite events; do not add parallel API.

episodes.name: learning_20260315_165200
episodes.content: **St Pulse Docker Bug**: Check that SummitFlow API container has /host-home volume mount before using st pulse. Container git operations use host paths that do not exist inside Docker without the mount. Known 500 error source when volume is missing.

episodes.name: learning_20260420_222044
episodes.content: **Overlay freshness**: Use the latest-tail scrollback_page as the overlay cache and display, even when it is shorter. Never keep an older overlay cache only because it has more lines. Why: Older longer cache entries can keep the first overlay page stale until a hard refresh.

episodes.name: learning_20260423_032108
episodes.content: **st autonomous enable scope**: Treat `st autonomous enable` as a local SummitFlow agent-config toggle, not as a re-enable of Agent Hub project execution permissions. Why: SummitFlow work pickup stayed disabled until Agent Hub `project_permissions.auto_exec_enabled` was patched separately, even after `st autonomous enable` returned success.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_140514
episodes.content: **Jenny Telegram delivery**: Use Hermes cron for Jenny Telegram reports. Never assume Agent Hub/Jenny has native Telegram delivery. Why: Telegram is currently wired through Hermes as the operator edge.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_190912
episodes.content: **Scheduler tests**: Use init_worker_credentials() before local execute_job() tests for persona scheduled jobs. Never treat a direct local Codex auth failure there as live routing breakage until worker credentials are loaded. Why: Local test paths can miss the worker credential cache.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_134443
episodes.content: **Overlay width shift root cause**: Treat A-Term overlay column bumping as a width mismatch first. xterm FitAddon subtracts 14px when scrollback is enabled, so the overlay opens narrower than the live TUI terminal when live uses scrollback=0. Why: Reserve the same 14px right rail in the live TUI terminal to keep columns aligned.

episodes.name: learning_20260202_155245
episodes.content: **Shared Ports**: Use the fixed project ports from config or project index. Never allocate per-task ports or per-checkpoint services. Why: shared-checkout flow removed hashed port offsets and helper daemons.

episodes.name: learning_20260426_153620
episodes.content: **Reference Repo Maintenance**: Treat ~/references checkouts as read-only for content edits, commits, and active-work modifications. When the user explicitly asks to update a reference checkout, clone maintenance such as git fetch, git pull --ff-only, or reclone is allowed. Why: read-only rule prevents modifying reference project content, not keeping reference clones current.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional context:User clarified on 2026-04-26 after pi-mono update.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_141601
episodes.content: **Hermes gateway log location**: Use `journalctl --user-unit hermes-gateway` to inspect gateway logs on this install; the systemd user service writes stdout/stderr to the journal rather than `~/.hermes/logs/gateway.log`. Why: `hermes logs gateway` reported no gateway.log while the live user service unit sets StandardOutput=journal and journalctl shows current gateway events.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_223823
episodes.content: **Memory Utility Score**: Treat memory utility as normalized cited-vs-loaded ratio in 0..1. Cap over-cited memories at 1.0. Use same normalized contract for Memory.utility_score, analytics averages, and top-memory sorting so /memory never renders utility above 100%.

episodes.name: learning_20260327_175906
episodes.content: **Command Guard**: Use the shared SummitFlow command guard for bash redirects and destructive git blocking across Claude, Codex, and Agent Hub. Never add per-client command blocks when the shared guard can enforce the rule once.

episodes.name: learning_20260429_173634
episodes.content: **SummitFlow Graph Tab**: Use /projects/:id/graph for Graphify visualization. Serve graphify-out/graph.html through /api/projects/:id/graphify/html and refresh with graphify update root. Large repos use aggregated community HTML; use query/path/explain for node detail.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_140720
episodes.content: **Portfolio AI prediction v1 state**: Treat Portfolio AI market prediction as measured but not adaptively weighted. Why: Runs, calls, votes, and evaluations persist. Seat synthesis is equal-weighted. Source-cluster weights are null/tracked-not-ranked.

episodes.name: learning_20260312_162654
episodes.content: **st agents update memory-config**: Use `st agents update <slug> --memory-config-file <path>` to replace an agent's memory config from a file. Use `--clear-memory-config` to remove the agent memory config on update.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_004835
episodes.content: **Terminal Native Runtime**: Run both terminal-api (`summitflow-terminal.service` on 8002) and terminal-web (`summitflow-terminal-frontend.service` on 3002) natively under `systemd --user`. Reason: the terminal stack needs direct tmux, Codex/Claude CLI, browser helper, and project-directory access, so Docker is not the normal runtime path.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_154054
episodes.content: **SMB probe path**: Use `cd project-backups; ls` to probe SMB backup availability. Never probe the share root or a new project directory. Why: This NAS denies root listing, and new project dirs do not exist until upload creates them.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_113057
episodes.content: **Jenny coaching loop**: Use coaching passes to monitor heartbeats, sessions, permissions, task outcomes, and tool results. Do not let coaching add bloat or substitute for Jenny's routine work. Why: The user wants Hermes to remove friction and keep Jenny lean rather than acting as a second runtime.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_145002
episodes.content: **Browser Dependency Gap**: Avoid trusting Hermes browser or local Playwright Chromium here until libnspr4 is installed. Never debug app rendering from an about:blank empty DOM alone. Why: The browser runtime can fail before navigation while the app is healthy.
episodes.summary: Browser blank DOM on libnspr4 gap

episodes.name: learning_20260316_164906
episodes.content: **Proxmox Testbed**: Use davion-gem (192.168.8.233) as test hypervisor. Test VM 100 at 192.168.8.234 (8 cores, 16GB, Docker, Chrome :9222, Lightpanda :9223, onboot=1). SSH: kasadis@234 from prod. API: https://233:8006. Template 9000 is read-only base.

episodes.name: learning_20260420_225420
episodes.content: **SummitFlow CI agent-hub checkout**: Use repo secret AGENT_HUB_REPO_TOKEN for SummitFlow Actions checkout of private elias-leslie/agent-hub. Why: Default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read that private repo.

episodes.name: learning_20260423_125632
episodes.content: **Named Hermes profiles**: Use per-profile audits before reusing named Hermes profiles. Never assume `coder` or `research` match `default`; they omit `sf_handoff` and carry stale built-in memories. Why: This workspace has profile drift between `default` and the named profiles.

episodes.name: learning_20260307_171708
episodes.content: **Thesis Invalidation**: If invalidation triggers are missing or unclear, prefer review or avoid. A thesis without a kill switch is not actionable.

episodes.name: learning_20260423_222352
episodes.content: **Task-shape Critique**: Treat task-shape critique as advisory. Never block readiness, autocode pickup, or replan on NEEDS_REVISION/pending alone. Use concrete findings only.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_004919
episodes.content: **Reverse Proxy Stack**: Use Cloudflared tunnel (system service) for external HTTPS and Caddy (system service) for LAN wildcard TLS (*.summitflow.dev via Cloudflare DNS). Check /etc/caddy/Caddyfile and /etc/cloudflared/config.yml for routing rules.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:85 status:provisional context:Post-migration review 2026-03-16

episodes.name: learning_20260422_001324
episodes.content: **Hermes legacy vision routing**: Treat legacy Hermes `auxiliary.vision.provider=main` as main provider plus main model. Why: Without the main model, Codex vision can fall back to `gpt-5.2-codex` and fail on ChatGPT-backed Codex accounts.

episodes.name: learning_20260318_145307
episodes.content: **Scroll History**: Never revert to pre-Mar17 code expecting working agent-session scroll. Desktop wheel scrolling for agent/TUI sessions was built in ce38b9a (Mar 18). All earlier snapshots (Mar 10-16) send arrow keys on alternate screen, causing command-history scroll. Verified by testing 7 worktree snapshots 2026-03-18.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:100 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: learning_20260428_185612
episodes.content: **Queue Cleanup**: Use st pulse, ready-all, and duplicate grouping before cancelling tasks. Keep one canonical task, log duplicate IDs there, then cancel copies with that canonical ID. Never delete task metadata.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_174259
episodes.content: **Proxmox VM CPU**: Use `qm set <vmid> -cpu host` on all VMs. Default kvm64 lacks x86-64-v2 flags, breaking sharp and other native Node modules. Reboot VM after change.

episodes.name: learning_20260315_165137
episodes.content: **Docker Compose Architecture**: Use ~/summitflow/docker/compose/docker-compose.yml as the single compose file with --profile full. Never add env_file directives or run docker compose down -v.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:80 type:anti_pattern status:provisional

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:51:23.152770+00:00
episodes.content: **Route Order**: FastAPI specific routes (/effective-rules) before parameterized (/{standard_id}). Otherwise string matches param type, causes 422 error. Example: /foo/specific-path before /foo/{param_id}.

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-02T17:14:28.445204+00:00
episodes.content: **Shared Checkout**: Use the project checkout for task work. Claim the task to create checkpoint metadata and task branch, then keep working from repo root.

episodes.name: learning_20260323_215308
episodes.content: **Web Research Verification**: Use `web-research research --query "..."` or fetch the cited page directly before answering or dispatching. Never answer from search-result snippets alone. When using `web-research search`, follow it with `web-research fetch --url "..."`. Use `--focus-query "..."` on long pages.

episodes.name: learning_20260316_004931
episodes.content: **Compose Health Deps**: Fix web service depends_on to use condition: service_healthy (summitflow-web, agent-hub-web, portfolio-web). Currently simple list format starts containers before APIs are ready.

episodes.name: learning_20260422_164315
episodes.content: **Jenny session continuity**: Use live session continuity for Jenny. Never leave `live_sessions_enabled` off when evaluating Jenny statefulness. Why: Persona memory config drift had `live_sessions_enabled=false`, which weakened cross-session statefulness.

episodes.name: learning_20260421_173615
episodes.content: **Project-switch state restore**: Use the detached target pane's own active_mode when switching back to it. Never overwrite an existing detached target pane with the source pane mode. Why: Source-mode overrides can replace the target pane's agent session.

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:51:30.701154+00:00
episodes.content: **Credentials Location**: Use ~/summitflow/docker/compose/.env as single credential store (~/.env.local symlinks to it). Contains passwords, DB URLs, client IDs, Redis URLs, VAPID keys, SMB config.

episodes.name: learning_20260318_143405
episodes.content: **Scrollback Sync All Modes**: Never gate ScrollbackSyncScheduler on SHELL_MODE. Agent/TUI apps use alternate screen buffer — xterm.js accumulates no scrollback from it. tmux capture-pane snapshots are the ONLY scroll history source. Gating tried 2026-03-18, immediately killed scroll. Fix TUI redraw at write-queue or DEC 2026 layer instead.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:100 type:anti_pattern status:canonical
episodes.summary: Never gate scrollback sync by mode

episodes.name: learning_20260307_204040
episodes.content: **Lane Truth**: Use `/api/ownership/projects/{project_id}/live` and `st sessions ownership` as normalized lane truth. Expect owner lanes deduped by `task_id + branch + working_dir` while raw session lists still show extra specialists.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:2026-03-07 coordination hardening across agent-hub + summitflow

episodes.name: learning_20260307_204040
episodes.content: **Ownership Endpoint**: Use `active_owners` plus `active_specialists` in `/api/ownership/projects/{project_id}/live`. Collapse duplicate owner lanes by `task_id + branch + working_dir` and prefer the scoped representative.
episodes.source_description: reference reference source:learning confidence:95 status:canonical context:2026-03-07 Agent Hub live ownership inventory hardening

episodes.name: learning_20260422_141816
episodes.content: **Jenny multi-task autonomy**: Use multiple safe tasks across multiple permitted projects in one heartbeat or session when that is best. Do not impose arbitrary one-task or one-project caps on Jenny. Why: The user explicitly wants Jenny and her agents free to do as many safe tasks as they judge appropriate.

episodes.name: anti-patterns
episodes.content: Terminal anti-patterns: NEVER hardcode session UUIDs in tests (use fixtures). NEVER use setTimeout for WebSocket timing (use event listeners). NEVER direct PTY reads during tmux operations (use tmux capture-pane -p). NEVER mix tmux and direct terminal I/O. NEVER skip wheelCleanup/touchCleanup before dispose(). NEVER assume session is alive after create (poll status). NEVER non-blocking waitpid after SIGKILL (use retry loop). NEVER query one session per mode for cleanup (use get_all_project_sessions).

episodes.name: learning_20260312_131645
episodes.content: **Prompt Authoring**: Run st prompt measure before/after prompt edits. Start goal-first; ordered workflow only when order matters, then constraints, output contract, verification. Keep durable rules once in DB prompt; move variable context/examples to task prompts or variables.

episodes.name: learning_20260313_151648
episodes.content: **Prompt Examples**: Use examples only when they anchor output shape, edge-case behavior, or tool or format usage better than prose. Prefer short positive examples with one consistent format; avoid large example sets unless evals prove the extra tokens improve outcomes.
episodes.summary: Examples only when they earn tokens

episodes.name: learning_20260307_171748
episodes.content: **Finance Memory Tags**: Tag investing learnings with finance-relevant so finance agents can retrieve them. Untagged project references are ignored by finance-only memory filters.

episodes.name: learning_20260318_145259
episodes.content: **Scrollback Sync Timers**: Never set SCROLLBACK_SYNC_DELAY or QUIET to 2.0s — kills scrolling completely. Use 0.05s delay + 0.5s quiet (current working values). Main branch has 2s+TUI-cooldown which suppresses sync so aggressively that no snapshots reach xterm, leaving nothing to scroll. Verified 2026-03-18.
episodes.source_description: guardrail guardrail source:learning confidence:100 type:anti_pattern status:canonical

episodes.name: learning_20260310_130035
episodes.content: **Memory Format**: Use st memory format/save for durable learnings. Store one compact atomic rule with bold topic, direct imperative wording, summary, context_kind, and applicability when known. Prefer <=3 sentences and <=280 chars because source quality prevents curation debt.
episodes.source_description: mandate mandate source:learning confidence:96 status:canonical context:Canonical formatting rule for mandate/guardrail/reference episode content after validator tightening

episodes.name: learning_20260309_205555
episodes.content: **Monkey Fight Testing**: UI verification: node scripts/verify-ui.js. E2E: node scripts/e2e-verification.js. Build check: npm run build (must succeed, zero TS errors). Dev server: npm run dev, then check localhost:4001. Check browser console for Phaser asset load warnings on TitleScene.

episodes.name: chat_2026-01-31T16:54:33.000890+00:00
episodes.content: **Frontend API Config Pattern**: Frontend projects must have lib/api-config.ts with getApiBaseUrl(), getWsUrl(), buildApiUrl(path). Use runtime hostname detection, not environment variables for URLs. Exception: CF Access protected APIs use Next.js rewrites for same-origin routing.

episodes.name: learning_20260312_131645
episodes.content: **Preview And Eval Prompt Edits**: Use runtime preview and evals before and after prompt edits. Optimize the biggest repeated sections first, keep examples short and canonical, and prefer one strong rule once over the same rule restated in multiple prompt layers.

episodes.name: learning_20260302_044714
episodes.content: **Cloudflare Workers AI**: 5 LLM models (qwen2.5-coder-32b, mistral-small-3.1-24b, qwen3-30b, qwq-32b, llama-4-scout-17b) + 3 image models (flux-1-schnell, sd-xl-lightning, flux-2-dev). Vendor prefixes in _CLOUDFLARE_MODEL_MAP: @cf/mistralai/ (not @cf/mistral/), @cf/qwen/, @cf/meta/. SD XL returns raw bytes (not JSON). FLUX.2-dev always requires multipart.

episodes.name: learning_20260311_213420
episodes.content: **ST Search CLI**: Use st search <query> for precision search. Use st search --text <query> for content search. Use --path <subtree> to stay inside one subtree or file prefix. Why: Key flags: --budget, --limit, --json, --symbols, --file, --scope auto|project|checkout, and --path. auto stays project-only on clean lanes and overlays checkout changes only on dirty lanes.

episodes.name: learning_20260312_141046
episodes.content: **st agents preview**: Use `st agents preview <slug>` to inspect an agent's effective runtime prompt/context. Prefer it over direct API inspection for assembled prompt sections or size checks. Use `--json` for before/after section and token counts; use `--full-context-only` when you need only the final injected context.

episodes.name: chat_2026-02-24T16:56:56.483240+00:00
episodes.content: **Ports**: Use SummitFlow 8001/3001, Agent Hub 8003/3003, Portfolio AI 8000/3000, Terminal 8002/3002, Monkey Fight 4001, PostgreSQL 5432, Redis 6379, Hatchet gRPC 7070, and Hatchet health 8888. Run apps under `systemd --user`; keep only PostgreSQL, Redis, and Hatchet in Docker.
